code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK PINEHURST_DB.RAW.MERGE_POS_TRANSACTIONS_TASK
  WAREHOUSE = LOAD_WH
  SCHEDULE = '5 MINUTE'
  WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA(
    'PINEHURST_DB.RAW.POS_TRANSACTIONS_STREAM')
AS
MERGE INTO PINEHURST_DB.CURATED.POS_TRANSACTIONS_CLEAN AS tgt
USING (... FROM ...POS_TRANSACTIONS_STREAM) AS src
ON tgt.TRANSACTION_ID = src.TRANSACTION_ID
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ...
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...;
